PART 1 SCOPE 1.1 This standard ( Part 3 ) covers the dimensional, performance and general requirements of electrically operated MTP suction apparatus together with the applicator required for medical termination of pregnancy. 2 REFERENCES 2.1 The Indian Standards listed in Annex necessary adjuncts to this standard. 3 TYPES 3.1 MTP suction apparatus shall be of two types : A are 3 ELECTRICALLY OPERATED 5.2 Rubber Components The rubber components shall be made of good quality natural or synthetic rubber and shall be capable of ageing in an air-oven for 168 hours at 70 f 1�C without showing appreciable stiffening, softening, cracking or other changes in condition. 5.3 Glass Parts The glass parts shall be made of clear glass or borosilicate glass. They shall be free from visual defects and internal strains. 5.4 Plastic Parts The raw material used for plastic suitable for the purpose intended. 5.5 Fibreglass Parts The fibre glass purpose intended. 5.6 Aiuminium used shall be suitable for the parts shall be

4 Type A

( Li@t Duty ) - The apparatus in which the vacuum unit is mounted on a base and provided with a carrying handle, for' use in locations where inflammable or explosive gases are not present.

b)

Type B ( Heavy Duty ) - The apparatus with explosion-proof electrical components construction, having totally enclosed mounted on a trolley with castors, suitable for use in hospitals in those locations where inflammable and explosive gases are likely to be present, such as, operation theatres. Bottles may be of glass or unbreakable non-collapsible plastic. The lid and its connections to the suction bottle shall provide a leakproof assembly. It shall be capable of easy removal and shall stand steam sterilization at not less than 120�C. The bottle shall be graduated at 50 ml intervals. Terminals 7.10 The MTP unit shall be provided with suitable bacteria1 filter cartridge between suction bottle and suction pump to protect it from entrained bacterias, moisture or from flooding due to overflow of suction bottle. The filter cartridge shall have provision for easy replacement of hlters and it shall be possible to clean the traps easily. 9 WORKMANSHIP 9.1 Cannula

9.1.1 All surfaces of cannula shall be free from scales and other derects. pits, dents, burrs, Working end of cannula shall be well formed. 9.1.2 The cannula provided shall conform to Fig. 1. 7.11 Switches and Wiring The switches and wiring used shall be rated to handle the maximum load that may occur under normal operating conditions and continuous use. The switches shall be so placed and fixed as to be convenient to operate and shall not become defective or loose during the operation. They shall be explosion proof and shall be marked to indicate the `OFF' and `ON' positions. 7.12 The vacuum unit shall be explosion proof and shall produce sparks during operation. It shall be mounted in such a way as to produce minimum vibrations. 7.13 The MTP unit shall work with minimum noise and shall satisfy the test in 10.7. 7.14 Castor wheels Type B MTP units. shall be provided only with

9.2 Valves and Stopcocks All valves and stopcocks shall be leakproof.

9.3 The suction apparatus shall be free from any imperfections which may affect its appearance or impair its serviceability. The apparatus shall operate smoothly and noiselessly and shall perform its functions efficiently in a manner suitable for the purpose intended.
- It is important that continuity of contact between various metallic parts is maintained. To ensure this, the holes to receive rubber buffers should be drilled and tapped after stoving to remove any enamel or other insulating material as the antistatic properties of th: rubber buffers or lining could be destroyed by an insulating linish. Cross lines, at a distance of 1 to 1'5 mm apart. and inclined at 12O"C, shall be inscribed over the marked portion with a pointed instrument. Thereafter, cellulose tape shall be applied over this portion and left for two minutes; after which it shall be jerked free from the painted surface. If more than 5 percent of the squares are ripped away from the painted surface and are adhering to the cellulose tape, the whole surface of the apparatus shall be repainted and again subjected to this test now at two conveniently selected spots and the item considered passing only if found satisfactory in both the cases. 10.2 The complete system shall leakproofness. There shall be vacuum in the apparatus. be checked no leakage for of

10.7 The noise level shall be such that the noise level meter when situated at a distance of 1'2 m from the machine, shall not record an increase greater than 10 dB when the background noise level is 45 dB. The instrument shall be in accordance with IS 9779 : 1981 using A-weighing network. 11 INSTRUCTIONS MANUAL

11.1 Each suction apparatus shall be provided with a manual giving necessary instructions and precautions to be taken for its proper use. The instruction manual shall include technical specifications of the apparatus and a list of accessories and spare parts supplied with the equipment. 12 MAKKING 12.1 The suction apparatus shall be marked clearly and indelibly in accordance with 7 of IS 302 : 1979 on its outer surface or on a plate firmly attached to it. In addition, there shall be permanent marking at the appropriate place to indicate the following: a) The direction in which the vacuum valve shall be turned to obtain an in suction, b) Position of `exhaust outlet', and control increase

10.3 The tubings shall be capable of withstanding a vacuum of 700 mm of Hg without collapsing. 10.4 For Type A apparatus, the unit shall be capable of giving a vacuum of 500 mm of mercury column in 10 seconds and 600 mm of with a mercury column within 60 seconds minimum free air displacemment rate of 25 l/min when measured up to 200 metres above the mean sea level. The unit shall be mounted in such a way as to produce minimum vibrations. For Type B apparatus, the unit shall be capable of giving a vacuum of 500 mm of mercury column in 10 seconds and 700 mm of mercury column within 50 seconds with a minimum free displacement rate of 25 to 30 l/min when measured up to 200 metres above the mean sea level. The vacuum unit shall be explosion proof and shall not produce sparks during operation. It shall be mounted in a such a way as to produce minimum vibrations. 4

c) Any other important precaution regarding the use of the apparatus and other components. 12.2 The following instruction regarding change of filter shall be marked at appropriate place on the apparatus: `The filter provided with the apparatus should be changed after every normal days use.' 12.3 The unit shall be marked of the source of manufacture. with the indication

12.4 Cannula shall also be marked with the indication of the source of manufacture and size number and `SS' if made of stainless steel. 13 PACKING 13.1 The MTP suction apparatus shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. Care shall be taken to that there is no contact between different components ensure and that it is not damaged during transportation.
